leads.name: Emo Court Wellingtonia Avenue
leads.location: Emo Court, Co. Laois, register record 551 at 53.10598,-7.19639 (Heritage Trees of Ireland, Landmark trees, avenue, 100-150 years)
leads.reason: Verify pass 2026-11-03: avenue, not one collectible tree (rule: avenue is blocked as a point). Sources: laois.ie and Heritage Ireland (mile-long, longest most complete Wellingtonia avenue in Ireland, planted 1850s; OPW tree-planting restoration 2019, Irish Times 2012 'planted in the 1850s'). Decision for Hidde: the avenue is the destination at Emo, one place to stand at the house end could be a single point; no individual tree measured.

leads.name: Emo Court 450-year-old oak
leads.location: Emo Court, Co. Laois; register record 525 pollard oak 300-500 years at 53.10893,-7.19798 (approx)
leads.reason: Verify pass 2026-11-03: Irish Times 2012 (Sylvia Thompson) lists 'a 450-year-old oak tree' in the gardens; register record 525 (Quercus robur, pollard, 300-500 years at 2009, 'significant habitat') is a possible match but nothing ties the two; no tree-level source, no second source, no measurement. Would ship with one more source or a photo.
